title: Connections and naïve lifting of DG modules
summary: In this paper, we generalize the notion of connections, which was introduced by Alain Connes in noncommutative differential geometry, to the differential graded (DG) homological algebra setting. Then, along a DG algebra homomorphism $A \to B$, where $B$ is assumed to be projective as an underlying graded $A$-module, we give necessary and sufficient conditions for a semifree DG $B$-module to be naïvely liftable to $A$ in terms of connections.
